summary: Red before the contract: the harden change and the archived co-op mission requirement named the OpFor but specified nothing about who drives it, so server-owned opponent turns, the no-grant rule, deterministic identity and replay had no source contract (grep of the baseline delta and archived requirement). Failure QA recorded in a temporary ledger copy: with PAIC incomplete, PAI stays blocked as shipped, and the validator does not itself enforce predecessor completion for a planned state (disclosed; PAI release is the parent ledger edit gated on PAIC mainProof). Lane A reproduced the temp-ledger result.
